notes: Topic codes are permanent and carry no meaning. Moving a topic between units changes homeUnit, never code.
Unit codes are stable. Renaming a unit changes name only.
crossRefs list every other unit under which this topic should surface in filters. The topic is stored once.

Emergency Medicine (U11) retains only conditions with no parent discipline. Acute presentations of conditions owned elsewhere are surfaced via the item-level emergency tag, not by duplicating the topic here.
U37 Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Health is unit 1 of the RACGP curriculum. Its code is U37 because codes are assigned on creation and never renumbered; displayOrder places it first.
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander content that belongs to another clinical unit is tagged atsi-relevant at item level rather than duplicated as a topic here.

depth: Core = GP diagnoses and manages, full wiki page, multiple items. Working = GP recognises, initiates, refers or co-manages; medium page, 1-2 items. Awareness = GP recognises and refers; a few paragraphs, 0-1 items. Depth is a property of the topic, set once, and drives both wiki length and item quota.

status/mergedInto: codes are never deleted or reused. A duplicate is resolved by setting status='merged' and mergedInto=[surviving codes]; the entry remains so existing item, wiki and citation references still resolve. Merged labels are preserved in the survivor's variants.

Deduplication pass taxonomy-dedupe-001 applied 2026-08-10. Survivor rule: the higher depth tier survives; where tiers are equal the condition survives and the approach label moves to variants; a compound entry is retired in favour of its components at Core depth, and retained in favour of its components at Awareness depth.
